the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find the uniform separator row or column.
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            return [
                [3 if top[i][c] == bottom[i][c] else 4
                 for c in range(w)]
                for i in range(min(len(top), len(bottom)))
            ]

    for c in range(w):
        if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1:
            left_width, right_width = c, w - c - 1
            width = min(left_width, right_width)
            return [
                [3 if grid[r][j] == grid[r][c + 1 + j] else 4
                 for j in range(width)]
                for r in range(h)
            ]
```

```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    if h % 2 == 1 and len(set(grid[h // 2])) == 1:
        mid = h // 2
        a, b = grid[:mid], grid[mid + 1:]
        shared = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
        bg = min(shared)
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else bg for c in range(w)]
                for r in range(mid)]

    if w % 2 == 1 and len({grid[r][w // 2] for r in range(h)}) == 1:
        mid = w // 2
        shared = set(v for row in grid for v in row[:mid]) & set(
            v for row in grid for v in row[mid + 1:])
        bg = min(shared)
        return [[3 if grid[r][c] == grid[r][w - 1 - c] else bg
                 for c in range(mid)] for r in range(h)]
```  
